work_item.summary: Validate Inventory Network Response and UI Data Consistency
work_item.pull_request: Not authorized; no PR was created.

classification.rationale: The supplied Jira metadata identifies EPMCDMETST-67315 as a Story.

test_plan.scope: Validate inventory loading from observed backend traffic through the Inventory UI, including successful and populated responses, product/detail consistency, displayed count, and loading-time errors.
scenarios: Positive end-to-end validation of inventory response and displayed products/details/count.
Negative/error detection for unsuccessful or empty responses, client-side errors, and missing or inconsistent UI data.
Edge/data consistency comparison of the complete response and rendered product list, including first and last products and count.

cases.title: Load inventory and verify backend data in the UI
cases.coverage: Positive end-to-end, UI, API/network, product details, displayed count, and loading errors.

cases.title: Detect inventory request, data, or loading errors
cases.coverage: Unsuccessful/empty response detection, client-side loading errors, and missing or inconsistent UI data.

cases.title: Compare the complete inventory list and count with the response
cases.coverage: Complete product-set and detail consistency, first/last products, and displayed count.

manual_test_cases.review_summary: All three cases passed test-case review for traceability, required coverage dimensions, and observable expected results.

jira_upload.details: The three linked test cases were created and are In Progress; the parent story is In Progress. No Jira update or story closure was performed during report generation.

automation.discovery: Six tests were discovered across two files, including all three generated inventory cases.

history: Initial review found missing loading-error assertions, uncovered separately displayed product-count assertions, and ambiguous response matching.
After retry 1, loading-error capture/assertions and unique response-candidate selection were added; the displayed-count gap remained and a duplicate manifest-property issue was identified.
After retry 2, duplicate manifest properties were removed and unique keys validated; the separately displayed product-count requirement remained uncovered. Final review remained OPEN_FIXES.
review.remaining_finding: Automation compares rendered-card count with matched response-record count but does not locate or assert a separately displayed product-count value. This is not equivalent coverage.

automation.review_waiver: The user authorized skipping the displayed-count review gate to proceed with execution only. The automation-review artifact remains FAIL; the waiver did not approve a test-case change or resolve the coverage gap.

execution.evidence: All six tests stopped at page.goto('/') with net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://127.0.0.1/ before application interaction.
execution.interpretation: This is an environment connectivity blocker, not evidence of a product failure. No product behavior was verified; the run provides no pass/fail conclusion about inventory behavior.

browser_verification.reason: The configured Playwright MCP browser tool/server was unavailable to the worker session; no alternate browser tool was used.

execution.self_heal: Not run. Failures occurred before application interaction because of environment connectivity, not demonstrated automation or product behavior.

residual_risks: The separately displayed inventory product count required by the approved cases is not asserted because repository/UI evidence did not identify a corresponding visible element. This remains uncovered and unverified.

Inventory network response, rendered product data, loading errors, and product-count behavior remain unverified because the application endpoint refused connections and browser verification was unavailable.
Automation review remains FAIL with verdict OPEN_FIXES despite the user-authorized progression waiver.

summary: Three manual cases were generated, reviewed, and linked to the story. Playwright automation mapped all three cases and six tests were discovered. Automation review remains OPEN_FIXES because a separately displayed product count is not asserted; the user waived that progression gate only. All six execution tests failed before app interaction because http://127.0.0.1/ refused connections, and configured Playwright MCP verification was blocked. These are environmental blockers, not verified product failures. No product behavior was verified, no self-heal was run, no PR was created, and the story/test cases remain In Progress.
